arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Wall argued the waiver limits liquid fuel vehicles.
Wall claimed vacating the waiver would redress the company's injury.
Kneedler argued the company seeks a categorical rule for redressability.
Klein stated federal courts do not assume standing exists.
